title: Specification 202 - Traffic Management
abstract:
Specification 202 is MRWA's primary specification for traffic management on road construction and maintenance contracts. It defines the contractual requirements that traffic management must comply with on MRWA-funded projects, complementing the Code of Practice with specific deliverables and administrative requirements.

The specification sets out requirements for traffic management planning, documentation, personnel competencies, inspections, and record keeping. It establishes the framework for traffic management submissions, including the required content of Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) and Traffic Guidance Schemes (TGSs).

Key requirements include minimum experience and accreditation levels for Traffic Management Supervisors, the inspection and audit frequency for traffic management setups, and the incident reporting and response requirements. This specification is contractually binding for MRWA projects and should be read alongside the Code of Practice and WHS legislation.
